name: eiasc-cril
description: EIASC Community Registration & Institutional Licensing Platform

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @eiasc/api && npm run build --workspace @eiasc/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @eiasc/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @eiasc/web
scripts.db:migrate: npm run db:ensure-baseline && prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:deploy: npm run db:ensure-baseline && prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:apply-registration-payments: prisma db execute --schema prisma/schema.prisma --file prisma/migrations/20260912100000_registration_payments/migration.sql && prisma db execute --schema prisma/schema.prisma --file prisma/migrations/20260912110000_registration_payment_settings/migration.sql && prisma db execute --schema prisma/schema.prisma --file prisma/migrations/20260912130000_digital_credentials/migration.sql && prisma db execute --schema prisma/schema.prisma --file prisma/migrations/20260912130100_digital_credential_automation/migration.sql && prisma db execute --schema prisma/schema.prisma --file prisma/migrations/20260912130200_fix_credential_token_encoding/migration.sql && prisma db execute --schema prisma/schema.prisma --file prisma/migrations/20260912140000_credential_configuration_designer/migration.sql && prisma db execute --schema prisma/schema.prisma --file prisma/migrations/20260912150000_credential_lifecycle_and_regional_config/migration.sql && prisma db execute --schema prisma/schema.prisma --file prisma/migrations/20260912151000_institution_registration_fee_default/migration.sql
scripts.db:bootstrap: npm run db:deploy && npm run db:seed && npm run db:import-geography && npm run db:export-geography && npm run db:verify-geography
